title: Continuous 3-D Latent Diffusion for Medical Image Generation and Reconstruction
abstract: High-resolution three-dimensional (3-D) medical latent diffusion remains limited by the cost of decoding full volumes, which existing latent autoencoders (AEs) handle through overlapping sub-volume decoding. We propose a continuous 3-D latent diffusion model framework for computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) generation and measurement-guided reconstruction, built on a coordinate-rendering autoencoder (CoRe-AE). Its decoder applies its convolutional stage once on the compact latent grid and renders voxel intensities from spatial coordinates through a lightweight implicit head, evaluated in memory-bounded chunks. This design avoids overlapping sub-volumes and remains differentiable with respect to the latent, so that the decoder can be used inside measurement-guided reconstruction. The framework was evaluated on CT volumes of 512\textsuperscript{3} voxels and MRI volumes of 256\textsuperscript{3} voxels. At 512\textsuperscript{3}, the decoder was 4--18 times faster than the MAISI and 3D MedDiffusion AEs and required the lowest peak graphics processing unit (GPU) memory, including when its gradient was computed. CoRe-AE also achieved the highest peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index (SSIM) among the evaluated AEs on both modalities. The resulting frozen 3-D latent prior generated full volumes without patch seams and, without retraining, reconstructed sparse-view CT and accelerated MRI through hard data consistency, within 2.4--4.9 dB PSNR of the pixel-domain decomposed diffusion sampler (DDS). A single volumetric latent prior thus supports both generation and reconstruction of high-resolution medical volumes on one GPU. Our code will be made available at https://github.com/Mellak/continuous-3d-latent-diffusion/.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2607.16491v3 的 20 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：promised。
analysis.ideaZh: 相对归档 v2，v3 将 continuous decoder 明确为 CoRe-AE，并新增 CLIF tile head、解码反向梯度/完整重建计时、fine-detail 与任务结构评估。作者现在报告 512³ decode 快4–18倍，但完整 latent-guided CT重建约1500s，反比 DDS1155s 慢；这是值得更新的效率边界，迁移价值限于 differentiable volumetric decoding。
analysis.motivationZh: 全分辨率医学 volume decoder 在 generation/inverse problem 中反复计算昂贵，分块 overlapping decoder 带来冗余和内存压力。
analysis.methodZh: 高分辨率先 depthwise 下采样，dense residual 只在小 grid 运算；LIIF 以邻接 latent feature 和相对坐标预测 voxel，CLIF 改成带 halo 的局部卷积 tile。convolutional feature decoder 每volume仅一次，轻量head分块查询，latent diffusion 在固定 grid 运行。inverse problem 复用 frozen prior，以 image-space correction/reencode 和末期 latent gradient guidance 接 ReSample。
methodFlow: 轻量下采样得到 compact 3D latent grid
LIIF coordinate chunks 或 CLIF halo tiles 渲染 voxels
冻结 AE 训练 3D diffusion prior
无条件生成或 ReSample measurement-guided correction
分块 decoder gradient 支持末期 latent optimization
analysis.experimentsZh: 700CT(512³)、540IXI MRI(256³)，subject splits；单48GB GPU，LIIF/CLIF与MAISI/MedDiffusion AE；40 volumes生成评估、每modality10重建volumes；测forward/gradient成本与分割评估。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告512³ LIIF/CLIF decoding7.8/8.7s、1.7/2.1GiB，baselines34.0–142.7s。（TableII p.6）；作者报告完整CT512³ guidance1494/1500s，image-only197/194s，DDS1155s。（TableS6 p.19） 对照范围：MAISI两window和MedDiffusion两压缩率；DDS pixel-space reconstruction更准确；MRI masking support不同，不能据FID宣布胜出。 消融与诊断：新增LIIF/CLIF、chunk/tile invariance、gradient/memory scaling、image-only/full schedule；显示收益来自避免重复decoder，而非新diffusion sampler。
analysis.insightZh: v2已有一次 feature-grid卷积+LIIF；v3新增 CLIF head 与系统梯度/端到端成本及结构评估，实质改变效率和 fidelity 的阅读结论，而非只换版本号。
analysis.evidenceZh: v3增加 CLIF 用 output-grid 邻域换取感知质量，并说明 tile halo 与 channel-only norm。（Sec.II-B pp.3–4; archived v2 Sec.II-B）；decode+gradient 以及完整 guidance 成本揭示 decoder速度不等于全流程更快。（TableII p.6; TablesS4–S6 pp.18–19）；细结构和 organ评估限制了仅靠Fidelity/FID的解释。（TablesIV–V pp.8–9; TablesS7–S8 p.20）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 针对已有continuous-volume表示的实质更新，memory-bounded differentiable decoder对3D representation有方法借鉴；临床应用本身不是接受理由。
analysis.caveatZh: AE细纹理平滑、frozen decoder限制重建、MRI support不匹配、仅40生成/10重建测试、无临床/多coil/记忆化验证（pp.10–12）。；医疗volume结果不证明通用mesh或object生成；收录理由是表示与新成本证据。；固定训练/测试分辨率未实测arbitrary-resolution能力；高resolution scaling部分为预测。；full reconstruction可能比pixel prior慢，不能沿用旧版笼统加速结论。
